meta.base: 2026年第十一版《深資童軍訓練綱要》；第十版過渡對照按 P022/2026 附件一另列
meta.baseEn: 2026 11th Edition Venture Scout Training Scheme; the 10th Edition transition is listed separately under P022/2026 Annex 1

badges.name: 會員章
badges.purpose: 幫助新成員認識所屬團體及接納誓詞規律
badges.enPurpose: To help new Venture Scouts get to know their Unit, be accepted, and accept the Scout Promise and Law
badges.description: 由團長與執行委員會商議後頒發。入團後三個月內完成。
badges.enDescription: Awarded by the Venture Scout Leader after consulting the Unit Executive Committee. Complete within three months of joining.

items.name: 參加最少六次團活動，而其中一次須為戶外活動
items.en: Participate in at least six Unit activities, one of which must be an outdoor activity
items.detail: 出席團活動6次，其中1次戶外（遠足、露營、服務）。新成員可與團內或團外深資一同參與。
items.enDetail: Attend 6 Unit activities, including 1 outdoor activity (hike, camp or service). New members may take part with Venture Scouts of their own Unit or another Unit.

items.name: 明瞭童軍運動的目的及人們對深資童軍的期望
items.en: Understand the aim of the Scout Movement and what is expected of Venture Scouts
items.detail: 1907年貝登堡創立，目的促進青少年全人發展。深資教育目標自務自治明日領袖。
items.enDetail: Founded by Baden-Powell in 1907 to promote the holistic development of young people. The educational aim of the Venture Scout Section is self-governing, self-programming future leaders.

items.name: 認識香港及世界童軍運動
items.en: Know Scouting in Hong Kong and the World Scout Movement
items.detail: 香港童軍總會架構總會/地域/區/旅團，WOSM世界童軍運動
items.enDetail: Structure of the Scout Association of Hong Kong: Headquarters / Region / District / Group. WOSM — World Organization of the Scout Movement.

items.name: 能辨認中華人民共和國國旗和國徽；並能說明其含意
items.en: Identify the National Flag and National Emblem of the People's Republic of China and explain their meaning
items.detail: 五星紅旗及國徽含意
items.enDetail: Meaning of the Five-star Red Flag and the National Emblem.

items.name: 能辨認香港特別行政區區旗和區徽；並能說明其含意
items.en: Identify the Regional Flag and Regional Emblem of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and explain their meaning
items.detail: 紅底白洋紫荊
items.enDetail: Red background with a white Bauhinia.

items.name: 明瞭設立國歌的用意，並能背唱之
items.en: Understand the purpose of the National Anthem and be able to sing it from memory
items.detail: 義勇軍進行曲，奏唱須肅立
items.enDetail: March of the Volunteers. Stand at attention when it is performed or sung.

segments.name: 禮節
segments.desc: 第11版：中式隊列及童軍升旗禮程序
segments.enDesc: 11th Edition: Chinese-style drill and Scout flag-break procedure

items.name: 認識宣誓時應有之童軍禮儀，以及中式隊列之基本動作
items.en: Know the Scout ceremonies for investiture and the basic movements of Chinese-style drill
items.detail: 宣誓禮儀 + 中式隊列：立正、稍息、向左/右轉、原地踏步、齊步走等
items.enDetail: Investiture etiquette and Chinese-style drill: attention, at ease, left/right turn, marking time, quick march, etc.

items.name: 認識在國歌奏唱和升掛國旗、區旗時表現應有之禮儀，以及升國旗及童軍升旗禮的基本程序
items.en: Know the proper etiquette when the National Anthem is performed and when the National or Regional Flag is hoisted, and the basic procedures of the National Flag hoisting and Scout flag-break
items.detail: 奏唱國歌肅立脫帽行注目禮，升國旗及童軍升旗禮程序
items.enDetail: Stand at attention, uncover and pay compliments during the National Anthem; procedures of National Flag hoisting and Scout flag-break.

items.name: 認識升掛國旗、區旗及展示國徽、區徽時的注意事項及使用之限制
items.en: Know the points to note and restrictions on hoisting the National and Regional Flags and displaying the National and Regional Emblems
items.detail: 國旗不得倒掛破損落地，不得用於商標，遵守國旗及國徽條例、區旗條例
items.enDetail: The National Flag must not be hung upside down, damaged or allowed to touch the ground, nor used as a trademark. Comply with the National Flag and National Emblem Ordinance and the Regional Flag Ordinance.

items.name: 示範國旗和區旗的升掛方法
items.en: Demonstrate how to hoist the National Flag and the Regional Flag
items.detail: 實際示範升掛國旗及區旗的正確步驟及方法
items.enDetail: Practically demonstrate the correct steps and method of hoisting the National Flag and the Regional Flag.

items.name: 接納童軍誓詞與規律
items.en: Accept the Scout Promise and Law
items.detail: 我願以信譽為誓，竭盡所能，對神明對國家盡責任，對別人要幫助，對規律必遵行。規律7條。
items.enDetail: On my honour, I promise that I will do my best to do my duty to God and to my Country, to help other people and to keep the Scout Law. Seven Scout Laws.

items.name: 完成下列其中一項：對保護兒童及青少年有基本認識並認識保護他們免受傷害的預防及處理方法；或完成「保護童軍成員免受傷害」網上自學課程
items.en: Complete either: a basic understanding of protecting children and young people and of prevention and handling to keep them safe from harm; or the “Safe from Harm” online self-learning course
items.detail: 認識侵害類型、預防（界限、透明、兩人同行）、處理（聆聽、記錄、報告）。或完成課程
items.enDetail: Know types of harm, prevention (boundaries, transparency, two-deep) and handling (listen, record, report); or complete the course.

links.title: Safe from Harm 自學課程

badges.name: 深資童軍肩章
badges.purpose: 提供階梯，讓剛獲會員章的深資對支部活動及童軍技能有基本認識
badges.enPurpose: A stepping stone so that newly invested Venture Scouts gain a basic knowledge of Section activities and scoutcraft
badges.description: 新成員通常應在加入後六個月內完成。可透過與團內或團外深資童軍參與兩日一夜或以上的度宿活動及團集會完成。童軍支部深資童軍先修章（Venture Scout Link Badge）可豁免「認識」部分；童軍標準獎章可豁免「童軍技能」部分，是否豁免由領袖按總會要求核實。
badges.enDescription: New members should normally complete this badge within six months. It can be completed through overnight activities of two days and one night or more with Venture Scouts from within or outside the Unit, and Unit meetings. The Venture Scout Link Badge earned in the Scout Section may exempt the Knowledge section; the Scout Standard Award may exempt the Scoutcraft section, subject to leader verification.

segments.name: (一)認識
segments.desc: 童軍支部已考獲「深資童軍先修章」的成員可以獲得豁免
segments.enDesc: Members who have gained the Venture Scout Link Badge in the Scout Section may be exempted

items.name: 說出深資童軍支部的目的、方法及預期成果
items.en: State the aim, method and expected outcomes of the Venture Scout Section

items.name: 認識深資童軍制服
items.en: Recognise the Venture Scout uniform

items.name: 明瞭深資童軍獎章及榮譽童軍獎章之四個考驗組別及考驗範圍
items.en: Understand the four assessment groups and scope of the Venture Scout Award and the Dragon Scout Award

items.name: 明瞭深資童軍獎章及榮譽童軍獎章與其他機構互相關連的地方
items.en: Understand how the Venture Scout Award and the Dragon Scout Award relate to other organisations

items.name: 說出執行委員會之基本功能
items.en: State the basic functions of the Executive Committee

items.name: 說出執行委員會之組織及委員的職責
items.en: State the organisation of the Executive Committee and the duties of its members

items.name: 明瞭執行委員會之產生方法
items.en: Understand how the Executive Committee is formed

items.name: 明瞭執行委員會中領袖的角色
items.en: Understand the role of leaders in the Executive Committee

items.name: 認識多元化的深資童軍活動
items.en: Know the diversity of Venture Scout activities

items.name: 參加最少一次深資童軍執行委員會會議
items.en: Attend at least one Venture Scout Executive Committee meeting

segments.name: (二)童軍技能 - 露營
segments.desc: 童軍支部已考獲「童軍標準獎章」的成員可以獲得豁免
segments.enDesc: Members who have gained the Scout Standard Award in the Scout Section may be exempted

items.name: 與團內或團外之深資童軍完成一次兩日一夜之露營
items.en: Complete a two-day one-night camp with Venture Scouts of your own Unit or another Unit

items.name: 準備一份適合兩日一夜小隊露營的個人及小隊物資清單
items.en: Prepare personal and patrol kit lists suitable for a two-day one-night patrol camp

items.name: 收拾一個兩日一夜露營用的背囊及個人急救藥囊
items.en: Pack a rucksack and a personal first-aid kit for a two-day one-night camp

items.name: 能正確架搭、收拾及存放一個營幕
items.en: Pitch, strike and store a tent correctly

items.name: 熟悉並正確地使用氣爐及摺刀，並知道有關之安全措施
items.en: Use a gas stove and a folding knife correctly and know the related safety measures

items.name: 設計一個兩日一夜小隊露營的食譜及單獨烹調其中一款菜式
items.en: Plan a menu for a two-day one-night patrol camp and cook one dish independently

items.name: 能以火柴及天然物生火
items.en: Light a fire with matches and natural materials

segments.name: (二)童軍技能 - 繩結

items.name: 示範下列繩結並說出其用途：平結、接繩結、八字結、雙套結、稱人結、繫木結、四方編結、十字編結及八字編結
items.en: Demonstrate the following knots and state their uses: reef knot, sheet bend, figure-of-eight knot, clove hitch, bowline, timber hitch, square lashing, diagonal lashing and figure-of-eight lashing

segments.desc: 童軍支部已考獲「童軍標準獎章」的成員可按總會要求獲豁免此童軍技能部分
segments.enDesc: Members who have gained the Scout Standard Award in the Scout Section may be exempted from this Scoutcraft part, subject to Association requirements.

segments.name: (二)童軍技能 - 遠足

items.name: 認識戶外活動時常用的地圖種類，明白不同圖例的意義
items.en: Know the types of maps commonly used in outdoor activities and understand map legends

items.name: 參與一個運用指南針及地圖之戶外活動，期間需示範正置地圖及利用指南針找出正確的前進方向
items.en: Take part in an outdoor activity using a compass and a map, and demonstrate setting the map and finding the correct direction of travel with a compass

segments.desc: 童軍支部已考獲「童軍標準獎章」的成員可按總會要求獲豁免此童軍技能部分
segments.enDesc: Members who have gained the Scout Standard Award in the Scout Section may be exempted from this Scoutcraft part, subject to Association requirements.

segments.name: (二)童軍技能 - 急救

items.name: 知道急救目的及原則
items.en: Know the aim and principles of first aid

items.name: 示範出血處理、傷口護理及簡單包紥的方法
items.en: Demonstrate the management of bleeding, wound care and simple bandaging

items.name: 示範燒傷、燙傷、抽筋及扭傷傷病者的處理方法
items.en: Demonstrate the management of burns, scalds, cramp and sprains

segments.desc: 童軍支部已考獲「童軍標準獎章」的成員可按總會要求獲豁免此童軍技能部分
segments.enDesc: Members who have gained the Scout Standard Award in the Scout Section may be exempted from this Scoutcraft part, subject to Association requirements.

badges.name: 深資童軍獎章
badges.purpose: 完成4個段章，建議以活動策劃段章為首個完成
badges.enPurpose: Complete 4 Achievement Badges; the Project Badge is recommended as the first to complete
badges.description: 完成深資童軍肩章後，使用 PT/65 與團長商討整體考驗計劃。深資童軍獎章包括活動策劃、社會服務、多元技能及戶外探險四個段章；完成任何一個段章即可按規定佩戴。
badges.enDescription: After completing the Venture Scout Epaulettes, discuss the overall assessment plan with the Venture Scout Leader using PT/65. The Venture Scout Award has four Badges: Project, Service, Multiple Skills, and Outdoor Exploration; wear each badge according to the scheme after completing it.

segments.name: 活動策劃段章
segments.desc: 舊自立段章，第11版新名。建議以此段章為首個完成段章。
segments.enDesc: Formerly the Self-reliance Achievement Badge (renamed in the 11th Edition). Recommended as the first Achievement Badge to complete.

items.name: 完成一個由區／地域／總會認許之「深資童軍執行委員會工作坊」
items.en: Complete a District / Region / Headquarters recognised “Venture Scout Executive Committee Workshop”
items.detail: 目標：透過「深資童軍執行委員會工作坊」，使深資童軍明瞭執行委員會制度及各項會議程序，強化活動策劃、人際關係與溝通技巧等。此外，同時拓展人脈，擴大社交圈子，認識更多同儕。
items.enDetail: Aim: Through the Venture Scout Executive Committee Workshop, Venture Scouts understand the Executive Committee system and meeting procedures, and strengthen programme planning, interpersonal and communication skills. It also widens their network and circle of peers.
items.tip: 建議以此段章為首個完成段章
items.enTip: Recommended as the first Achievement Badge to complete

segments.desc: 舊責任段章。完成選修部分(I)及選修部分(II)
segments.enDesc: Formerly the Responsibility Achievement Badge. Complete Elective Part (I) and Elective Part (II).

subItems.name: 精神健康急救 - 持有有效香港心理衛生會精神健康急救課程（標準版）或（關懷青少年版）證書
subItems.en: Mental Health First Aid — hold a valid Mental Health First Aid (Standard) or (Youth) certificate of the Mental Health Association of Hong Kong
subItems.detail: 香港心理衛生會，2026新增
subItems.enDetail: Mental Health Association of Hong Kong; new in 2026

subItems.name: SOUL Keeper 精神健康守護者課程 (Level 2) - 完成一個認許之「SOUL Keeper 精神健康守護者課程 (Level 2)」
subItems.en: SOUL Keeper Mental Health Guardian Course (Level 2) — complete a recognised SOUL Keeper Course (Level 2)

subItems.name: 共融大使 - 完成由區／地域／總會認許之深資童軍共融大使訓練班
subItems.en: Integration Ambassador — complete a District / Region / Headquarters recognised Venture Scout Integration Ambassador Course
subItems.enDetail: New in 2026

segments.name: 多元技能段章
segments.desc: 第十一版多元技能段章：三個範疇中完成任何一個；舊第十版對照只按 P022/2026 所列大類辦理，新要求須由領袖逐項核實。
segments.enDesc: 11th Edition Multiple Skills Achievement Badge: complete any one of the three areas. The old-to-new mapping follows only the category-level P022/2026 table; leaders must verify the new requirements item by item.
segments.requirement: 三範疇擇一獲段章，全部獲金帶
segments.enRequirement: Any one of three areas for the Achievement Badge; all three for the Bar

items.name: 範疇一：童軍技能
items.en: Category I: Scoutcraft
items.detail: 本範疇須完成先鋒工程、露營技藝及原野生活技能、步操三部分。第十版舊 A-101 至 A-104 只在 P022/2026 表內作範疇級對照，不代表舊細項已自動符合本版要求。
items.enDetail: Complete Pioneering, Campcraft and Backwoods Skills, and Footdrill. P022/2026 maps old A-101 to A-104 at category level only; old items are not automatically treated as meeting these requirements.

subItems.name: 先鋒工程
subItems.en: Pioneering
subItems.detail: (a) 完成由區、地域或總會舉辦的深資童軍繩結及先鋒工程訓練班；及 (b) 由3至5名深資童軍組隊，向區／地域／總會申請考核並完成兩項先鋒工程。每名成員須製作相應比例模型，活動前提交計劃，活動後一個月內交報告。例子：繩竹橋長不少於5米、高不少於1.5米；竹及繩搭建的瞭望台高不少於4米；空中滑輪索橋長不少於8米。組隊人數按官方附錄及主考指引核實。
subItems.enDetail: (a) Complete a Venture Scout Knotting and Pioneering Course organised by a District, Region, or Association Headquarters; and (b) form a team of 3 to 5 Venture Scouts, apply for assessment, and complete two pioneering projects. Each member makes a proportional model; submit a plan before the activity and a report within one month. Examples: a rope-and-bamboo bridge at least 5 m long and 1.5 m high; a bamboo-and-rope lookout tower at least 4 m high; or an aerial pulley rope bridge at least 8 m long. Confirm team size against the official appendix and assessor guidance.

subItems.name: 露營技藝及原野生活技能
subItems.en: Campcraft and Backwoods Skills
subItems.detail: 露營技藝部分選一：組隊並申請考核，完成兩日一夜固定營（按附錄提交計劃、個人報告並示範營務技能）；或完成認許的深資童軍營藝訓練班／考驗。原野生活部分另選一：組隊在團長指引下完成原野求生系列活動；或完成認許的深資童軍原野烹飪訓練班／考驗。兩部分均須完成。
subItems.enDetail: Campcraft: choose one—form a team, apply for assessment, and complete a two-day one-night standing camp (including the plan, personal report, and campcraft skills in the appendix); or complete a recognised Venture Scout Campcraft Course/Assessment. Backwoods Skills: separately choose one—complete a series of Backwoods Survival Skills activities with a team under the Venture Scout Leader; or complete a recognised Venture Scout Backwoods Cooking Course/Assessment. Both parts are required.

subItems.name: 步操
subItems.en: Footdrill
subItems.detail: 完成隊列訓練工作坊；及完成「基本禮儀及步操訓練班」或「步操基本訓練班」。開始考驗前已完成的相關部分可追溯認可；如已完成「童軍步操基本訓練班」，視作符合「步操基本訓練班」。
subItems.enDetail: Complete the Chinese Chinese Foot Drill Workshop; and complete either the Basic Etiquette and Foot Drill Training Course or Foot Drill Basic Training Course. Relevant parts completed before this assessment may be retrospectively recognised. The Scout Foot Drill Basic Training Course is treated as the Foot Drill Basic Training Course.

items.name: 範疇二：康樂體育
items.en: Category II: Physical Recreation
items.detail: 完成以下其中一條路線：兩項不同康樂／體育活動各累計不少於20小時（共不少於40小時）；或一項活動參與總時數不少於52小時。除活動本身外，須對所選活動的規則、術語及安全措施有足夠認識，了解該活動可能造成的傷患及預防方法，並向其他單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人分享參與心得。成員須自行擬定計劃，先諮詢主考人並取得同意才實行。活動例子詳見官方綱要，並非限於舊 A-301 至 A-312。
items.enDetail: Complete either: two different recreational/sports activities for at least 20 hours in total in each activity (at least 40 hours total); or one activity for a total of at least 52 hours. Candidates must know the selected activity’s rules, terminology and safety measures; understand possible injuries and prevention; and share takeaways with Venture Scouts from other Units, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. Draft a plan and obtain the assessor’s approval before starting. See the official syllabus for non-exhaustive examples; this is not limited to old A-301–A-312 badges.

subItems.name: 路線一：兩項不同活動，各不少於20小時
subItems.en: Route 1: two different activities, at least 20 hours each
subItems.detail: 選兩項不同活動，持續參與且每項累計不少於20小時；總時數不少於40小時。除活動本身外，須對所選活動的規則、術語及安全措施有足夠認識，了解該活動可能造成的傷患及預防方法，並向其他單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人分享參與心得。成員須自行擬定計劃，先諮詢主考人並取得同意才實行。活動例子詳見官方綱要，並非限於舊 A-301 至 A-312。
subItems.enDetail: Choose two different activities, each undertaken for at least 20 hours in total (at least 40 hours total). Candidates must know the selected activity’s rules, terminology and safety measures; understand possible injuries and prevention; and share takeaways with Venture Scouts from other Units, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. Draft a plan and obtain the assessor’s approval before starting. See the official syllabus for non-exhaustive examples; this is not limited to old A-301–A-312 badges.

subItems.name: 路線二：一項活動不少於52小時
subItems.en: Route 2: one activity for at least 52 hours
subItems.detail: 選一項活動，參與總時數不少於52小時。除活動本身外，須對所選活動的規則、術語及安全措施有足夠認識，了解該活動可能造成的傷患及預防方法，並向其他單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人分享參與心得。成員須自行擬定計劃，先諮詢主考人並取得同意才實行。活動例子詳見官方綱要，並非限於舊 A-301 至 A-312。
subItems.enDetail: Choose one activity and participate for a total of at least 52 hours. Candidates must know the selected activity’s rules, terminology and safety measures; understand possible injuries and prevention; and share takeaways with Venture Scouts from other Units, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. Draft a plan and obtain the assessor’s approval before starting. See the official syllabus for non-exhaustive examples; this is not limited to old A-301–A-312 badges.

items.name: 範疇三：新體驗
items.en: Category III: New Experience
items.desc: 須完成六類中的兩種不同類型；每項不少於20小時，並展示進步及分享成果。
items.enDesc: Complete two different types from the six categories; at least 20 hours each, showing improvement and sharing outcomes.
items.detail: 從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
items.enDetail: Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

subItems.name: 空中活動
subItems.en: Air Activities
subItems.detail: 包括但不限於飛機及直升機飛行員理論課、跳傘活動、飛行活動、各級空勤員章課程、飛行章課程及跳傘章課程。
subItems.enDetail: Includes but is not limited to aircraft and helicopter pilot theory, parachuting, flight activities, all levels of the Aircrew Badge syllabus, the Scout Wings course, and the Scout Canopy Wings course.

subItems.name: 海上活動
subItems.en: Sea Activities
subItems.detail:
包括但不限於獨木舟、獨木舟建造、獨木舟水球、龍舟、帆船、直立板（SUP）、SUP 水球、滑浪風帆、徒手潛水、獨木舟拯救及各級童軍標準艇課程。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Includes but is not limited to canoeing, canoe building, canoe polo, dragon boating, sailing, stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), SUP polo, windsurfing, free diving, canoe lifesaving, and all levels of the Scout Standard Boat syllabus.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

subItems.name: 資訊科技
subItems.en: Information Technology
subItems.detail:
包括但不限於電腦（例如人工智能應用）、網頁設計、可編程實體物件（例如 Arduino 及 micro:bit）、應用程式編寫、數據分析、業餘無線電及 3D 打印。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Includes but is not limited to computing (e.g. applications of artificial intelligence), web design, programmable physical objects (e.g. Arduino and micro:bit), application programming, data analysis, amateur radio, and 3D printing.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

activityOptions.name: 應用程式編寫／數據分析

subItems.name: 海外交流活動
subItems.en: Overseas Exchange Activities
subItems.detail:
參加需要至少五日住宿的海外交流活動，包括世界童軍大露營、國際或內地交流活動。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Participate in an overseas exchange activity requiring at least five days of residential stay, including a World Scout Jamboree or international / Mainland exchange activity.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

subItems.name: 藝術
subItems.en: Arts
subItems.detail:
包括但不限於書法、陶藝、繪畫、雕塑、平面設計、絲網印刷、菲林攝影、數碼攝影、電影理論及拍攝技巧、戲劇、音樂、時裝裁剪。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Includes but is not limited to calligraphy, pottery, painting, sculpture, graphic design, screen printing, film photography, digital photography, film theory and shooting techniques, drama, music, fashion tailoring.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

subItems.name: 興趣
subItems.en: Interests
subItems.detail:
包括但不限於護理、釣魚、林務、園藝、語言、氣象、集郵、辯論、魔術、家居烘焙、寵物急救、寵物護理、Certified Personality Dimensions® Facilitator（Level 1）及 MBTI® 認證。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Includes but is not limited to nursing, fishing, forestry, gardening, languages, meteorology, stamp collecting, debating, magic, home baking, pet first aid, pet grooming, Certified Personality Dimensions® Facilitator (Level 1), and MBTI® certification.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

segments.name: 戶外探險段章
segments.desc: 按旅程類型完成相應前設及一項戶外探險旅程；第十一版路程距離、日數、申請及安全要求以各選項及最新通告為準。
segments.enDesc: Complete the relevant prerequisites for the chosen route and one outdoor expedition. Follow the 11th Edition route distances, duration, application, and safety requirements and current circulars.

items.name: 前設訓練（按旅程類型）
items.en: Prerequisite training (depends on route)
items.detail: 徒步及單車旅程須先完成認可地圖閱讀及遠足／探險訓練；海上探險須先完成認可海上探險訓練。只有選擇相應旅程者才須完成該項前設。
items.enDetail: Hiking and cycling routes require recognised map-reading and expedition training first; sea expeditions require recognised sea-expedition training first. Complete only the prerequisite for the chosen route.

subItems.name: 深資童軍地圖閱讀訓練班／考驗（徒步及單車旅程）
subItems.en: Venture Scout Map Reading Course / assessment (hiking and cycling)
subItems.detail: 只適用於選擇徒步或單車旅程者。P022/2026 明列舊 E-A001 對照至本項；領袖仍須由成員選擇並核實是否記錄等同。
subItems.enDetail: Required only for hiking or cycling. P022/2026 explicitly maps old E-A001 to this training; the leader must still choose and verify any equivalence record.

subItems.name: 深資童軍遠足訓練班（徒步及單車旅程）
subItems.en: Venture Scout Hiking Training Course (hiking and cycling)
subItems.detail: 只適用於選擇徒步或單車旅程者，須於出發前完成。P022/2026 明列舊 E-A002「遠足訓練」對照至深資童軍遠足訓練班；領袖仍須由成員選擇並核實是否記錄等同。
subItems.enDetail: Required before a hiking or cycling expedition. P022/2026 explicitly maps old E-A002 Expedition Training to the Venture Scout Hiking Training Course; the leader must still choose and verify any equivalence record.

subItems.name: 認可海上探險訓練（海上旅程）
subItems.en: Recognised sea-expedition training (sea journeys)
subItems.detail: 只適用於選擇海上旅程者；按最新相關通告完成認可訓練。
subItems.enDetail: Required only for a sea journey; complete recognised training under the current circular.

items.name: 選修一項戶外探險旅程
items.en: Choose one outdoor expedition
items.detail: 旅程共同指引：旅程主要部分須在陌生地方進行；小組3至7人，混合性別小組每種性別至少2人。每名成員須擔任領導角色並負責導航，完成一項自選且對個人、社會或童軍運動有意義的事工／專題；旅程及專題紀錄須於完成後一個月內提交。重視充分計劃、意義及安全。境外徒步／單車旅程須至少提前六個月提交PT/71；境外自駕或機動化旅程須按官方表格至少提前六個月向青少年活動署申請。主考人可按路線難度、天氣或不可預見情況酌情處理指定距離／日數。所有境外及海上安排須遵守最新通告、風險評估及主考人指示。
items.enDetail: Common journey guidance: the major part of the expedition is in an unfamiliar place; teams have 3–7 members, with at least two members of each gender in a mixed-gender team. Each candidate takes a leading role and navigates, completes a self-chosen project meaningful to individuals, society, or Scouting, and submits expedition and project logbooks within one month. Plan a meaningful and safe journey. Overseas hiking/cycling requires PT/71 at least six months before departure; overseas driving/mechanical transport requires the relevant application to the Programme Branch at least six months in advance. Assessors may exercise discretion over distance/duration for route difficulty, weather, or unforeseen circumstances. Follow current circulars, risk assessments, and assessor instructions for overseas and sea journeys.

subItems.name: 境外機動化交通旅程：三日兩夜或以上，不少於1000公里；至少3個停留點
subItems.en: Overseas mechanical-transport expedition: at least three days and two nights, minimum 1000 km and 3 stops
subItems.detail: 只限境外旅程；最少3個停留點，每點停留不少於12小時。須完成相關表格並於出發前至少六個月向青少年活動署提出申請。旅程共同指引：旅程主要部分須在陌生地方進行；小組3至7人，混合性別小組每種性別至少2人。每名成員須擔任領導角色並負責導航，完成一項自選且對個人、社會或童軍運動有意義的事工／專題；旅程及專題紀錄須於完成後一個月內提交。重視充分計劃、意義及安全。境外徒步／單車旅程須至少提前六個月提交PT/71；境外自駕或機動化旅程須按官方表格至少提前六個月向青少年活動署申請。主考人可按路線難度、天氣或不可預見情況酌情處理指定距離／日數。所有境外及海上安排須遵守最新通告、風險評估及主考人指示。
subItems.enDetail: Overseas only; at least 3 stops, staying at each for at least 12 hours. Complete the relevant form and apply to the Programme Branch at least six months before departure. Common journey guidance: the major part of the expedition is in an unfamiliar place; teams have 3–7 members, with at least two members of each gender in a mixed-gender team. Each candidate takes a leading role and navigates, completes a self-chosen project meaningful to individuals, society, or Scouting, and submits expedition and project logbooks within one month. Plan a meaningful and safe journey. Overseas hiking/cycling requires PT/71 at least six months before departure; overseas driving/mechanical transport requires the relevant application to the Programme Branch at least six months in advance. Assessors may exercise discretion over distance/duration for route difficulty, weather, or unforeseen circumstances. Follow current circulars, risk assessments, and assessor instructions for overseas and sea journeys.

subItems.name: 海上探險旅程：三日兩夜或以上，不少於40公里
subItems.en: Sea expedition: at least three days and two nights, minimum 40 km
subItems.detail: 開始海上探險前須完成認可海上探險訓練；船艇、資格、安全及申請細則按最新相關通告及主考人指示核實。本綱要沒有把海上旅程分成標準艇／獨木舟／風帆等獨立考核選項。旅程共同指引：旅程主要部分須在陌生地方進行；小組3至7人，混合性別小組每種性別至少2人。每名成員須擔任領導角色並負責導航，完成一項自選且對個人、社會或童軍運動有意義的事工／專題；旅程及專題紀錄須於完成後一個月內提交。重視充分計劃、意義及安全。境外徒步／單車旅程須至少提前六個月提交PT/71；境外自駕或機動化旅程須按官方表格至少提前六個月向青少年活動署申請。主考人可按路線難度、天氣或不可預見情況酌情處理指定距離／日數。所有境外及海上安排須遵守最新通告、風險評估及主考人指示。
subItems.enDetail: Complete recognised sea-expedition training before the journey. Verify craft, qualifications, safety, and application details against current circulars and assessor instructions. The 11th Edition handbook does not split this into separate Scout Standard Boat / canoe / sailing routes. Common journey guidance: the major part of the expedition is in an unfamiliar place; teams have 3–7 members, with at least two members of each gender in a mixed-gender team. Each candidate takes a leading role and navigates, completes a self-chosen project meaningful to individuals, society, or Scouting, and submits expedition and project logbooks within one month. Plan a meaningful and safe journey. Overseas hiking/cycling requires PT/71 at least six months before departure; overseas driving/mechanical transport requires the relevant application to the Programme Branch at least six months in advance. Assessors may exercise discretion over distance/duration for route difficulty, weather, or unforeseen circumstances. Follow current circulars, risk assessments, and assessor instructions for overseas and sea journeys.

badges.name: 榮譽童軍獎章
badges.purpose: 青少年最高榮譽，需完成4條金帶，約2-4年，總領袖於大會操頒發
badges.enPurpose: The highest youth honour. Complete 4 Bars, typically in 2–4 years. Presented by the Chief Scout at the Scout Rally.
badges.description: 只可在完成相應深資童軍段章後開始該項金帶考驗。新舊制度均須按總會指定程序使用 PT/65、PT/19 及 PT/20；申請及頒發詳情以第十一版手冊及最新通告為準。
badges.enDescription: A Bar may only be started after completing its corresponding Venture Scout Achievement Badge. Use the Association’s required PT/65, PT/19, and PT/20 procedures for either scheme; follow the 11th Edition handbook and current circulars for application and presentation details.

segments.name: 活動策劃金帶
segments.desc: 舊自立金帶。完成下列其中一項
segments.enDesc: Formerly the Self-reliance Bar. Complete one of the following.

items.name: 實踐一項活動策劃
items.en: Carry out an activity-planning project
items.detail:
與其他旅團深資童軍、樂行童軍或青年人聯合組織大型活動。須活動前2個月向團長及金帶主考人申請及得到許可，活動前1個月呈交計劃書，完結後1個月內呈交報告書（包括會議文件、分工、財政報告、活動反思等）。必須由青年人或深資童軍成員主導。

開始金帶活動前須先完成由區、地域或總會舉辦的深資童軍執行委員會工作坊。
items.enDetail:
Jointly organise a major activity with Venture Scouts of other Groups, Rover Scouts or other young people. Apply to the Venture Scout Leader and the Bar assessor at least 2 months before the activity and obtain approval; submit a plan 1 month before; submit a report within 1 month after (including meeting papers, division of work, financial report and reflection). Must be led by young people or Venture Scouts.

Complete a Venture Scout Executive Committee Workshop organised by a District, Region, or Association Headquarters before undertaking the Bar activity.

items.name: 實踐一項活動策劃，該活動需外宿最少五日四夜
items.en: Carry out an activity-planning project involving at least five days four nights away from home
items.detail:
完成該選項可與香港青年獎勵計劃「團體生活科」銜接。詳細請參閱香港青年獎勵計劃的獎勵計劃手冊 - 團體生活科或與主考人聯絡。其餘條件同上。

開始金帶活動前須先完成由區、地域或總會舉辦的深資童軍執行委員會工作坊。
items.enDetail:
This option may be linked with the Residential Project of The Hong Kong Award For Young People. See the AYP handbook — Residential Project — or contact the assessor. Other conditions as above.

Complete a Venture Scout Executive Committee Workshop organised by a District, Region, or Association Headquarters before undertaking the Bar activity.

segments.name: 社會服務金帶
segments.desc: 舊責任金帶。完成下列其中一項
segments.enDesc: Formerly the Responsibility Bar. Complete one of the following.

items.name: (一) 童軍及社區服務
items.en: (1) Scout and Community Services
items.detail: 1. 童軍運動基本原則訓練班（單元1A及1B）；及 2. 童軍單位內進行四次或以上認許的服務，而時間總計不少於二十六小時；及 3. 為非童軍單位的社區服務，進行服務四次或以上，或策劃及執行有持續性的服務一次或以上（如適用），總計服務時間則不少於二十六小時。
items.enDetail: 1. Fundamental Principles of Scouting Course (Modules 1A and 1B); and 2. four or more recognised services within a Scout unit totalling not less than 26 hours; and 3. community service for a non-Scout unit on four or more occasions, or plan and carry out one or more ongoing services (where applicable), totalling not less than 26 hours.

items.name: (二) 志願服務
items.en: (2) Voluntary Services
items.detail: 經常參與一項六個月或以上之服務，總服務時間不少於52小時。承諾服務前，須對服務對象及所需技能有一定認識；不一定要有專業技能或證書，但須應用所學及持續服務。服務須於童軍例行活動以外進行，不可屬兼職／全職工作；如服務機構要求資格（例如急救、拯溺、家居護理、國旗升掛），須先取得相關證書。保存服務紀錄以備審核。
items.enDetail: Regularly participate in a service for at least six months and at least 52 hours in total. Before committing, understand the service targets and skills needed; specialised skills or certificates are not always required, but apply what you have learned and serve continuously. The service must be outside regular Scout activities and cannot be employment. If the service organisation requires a qualification (e.g. first aid, lifesaving, home care, or flag-raising), obtain the certificate first. Keep records for audit.

items.name: (三) 寰宇童軍計劃
items.en: (3) Scouts of the World Award
items.detail: 1. 完成寰宇童軍計劃「探索」課程；及 2. 組織行動小組完成「自願服務」。
items.enDetail: 1. Complete the Scouts of the World Award “Discovery” course; and 2. form an action team and complete “Voluntary Service”.

segments.name: 多元技能金帶
segments.desc: 第十一版多元技能金帶：須完成全部三個範疇；新細項不會因舊章等同紀錄而自動勾選。
segments.enDesc: 11th Edition Multiple Skills Bar: complete all three areas. New checklist items are not auto-ticked by an old-award equivalence record.

items.name: 範疇一：童軍技能
items.en: Category I: Scoutcraft
items.detail: 本範疇須完成先鋒工程、露營技藝及原野生活技能、步操三部分。第十版舊 A-101 至 A-104 只在 P022/2026 表內作範疇級對照，不代表舊細項已自動符合本版要求。
items.enDetail: Complete Pioneering, Campcraft and Backwoods Skills, and Footdrill. P022/2026 maps old A-101 to A-104 at category level only; old items are not automatically treated as meeting these requirements.

subItems.name: 先鋒工程
subItems.en: Pioneering
subItems.detail: (a) 完成由區、地域或總會舉辦的深資童軍繩結及先鋒工程訓練班；及 (b) 由3至5名深資童軍組隊，向區／地域／總會申請考核並完成兩項先鋒工程。每名成員須製作相應比例模型，活動前提交計劃，活動後一個月內交報告。例子：繩竹橋長不少於5米、高不少於1.5米；竹及繩搭建的瞭望台高不少於4米；空中滑輪索橋長不少於8米。組隊人數按官方附錄及主考指引核實。
subItems.enDetail: (a) Complete a Venture Scout Knotting and Pioneering Course organised by a District, Region, or Association Headquarters; and (b) form a team of 3 to 5 Venture Scouts, apply for assessment, and complete two pioneering projects. Each member makes a proportional model; submit a plan before the activity and a report within one month. Examples: a rope-and-bamboo bridge at least 5 m long and 1.5 m high; a bamboo-and-rope lookout tower at least 4 m high; or an aerial pulley rope bridge at least 8 m long. Confirm team size against the official appendix and assessor guidance.

subItems.name: 露營技藝及原野生活技能
subItems.en: Campcraft and Backwoods Skills
subItems.detail: 露營技藝部分選一：組隊並申請考核，完成兩日一夜固定營（按附錄提交計劃、個人報告並示範營務技能）；或完成認許的深資童軍營藝訓練班／考驗。原野生活部分另選一：組隊在團長指引下完成原野求生系列活動；或完成認許的深資童軍原野烹飪訓練班／考驗。兩部分均須完成。
subItems.enDetail: Campcraft: choose one—form a team, apply for assessment, and complete a two-day one-night standing camp (including the plan, personal report, and campcraft skills in the appendix); or complete a recognised Venture Scout Campcraft Course/Assessment. Backwoods Skills: separately choose one—complete a series of Backwoods Survival Skills activities with a team under the Venture Scout Leader; or complete a recognised Venture Scout Backwoods Cooking Course/Assessment. Both parts are required.

subItems.name: 步操
subItems.en: Footdrill
subItems.detail: 完成隊列訓練工作坊；及完成「基本禮儀及步操訓練班」或「步操基本訓練班」。開始考驗前已完成的相關部分可追溯認可；如已完成「童軍步操基本訓練班」，視作符合「步操基本訓練班」。
subItems.enDetail: Complete the Chinese Chinese Foot Drill Workshop; and complete either the Basic Etiquette and Foot Drill Training Course or Foot Drill Basic Training Course. Relevant parts completed before this assessment may be retrospectively recognised. The Scout Foot Drill Basic Training Course is treated as the Foot Drill Basic Training Course.

items.name: 範疇二：康樂體育
items.en: Category II: Physical Recreation
items.detail: 完成以下其中一條路線：兩項不同康樂／體育活動各累計不少於20小時（共不少於40小時）；或一項活動參與總時數不少於52小時。除活動本身外，須對所選活動的規則、術語及安全措施有足夠認識，了解該活動可能造成的傷患及預防方法，並向其他單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人分享參與心得。成員須自行擬定計劃，先諮詢主考人並取得同意才實行。活動例子詳見官方綱要，並非限於舊 A-301 至 A-312。
items.enDetail: Complete either: two different recreational/sports activities for at least 20 hours in total in each activity (at least 40 hours total); or one activity for a total of at least 52 hours. Candidates must know the selected activity’s rules, terminology and safety measures; understand possible injuries and prevention; and share takeaways with Venture Scouts from other Units, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. Draft a plan and obtain the assessor’s approval before starting. See the official syllabus for non-exhaustive examples; this is not limited to old A-301–A-312 badges.

subItems.name: 路線一：兩項不同活動，各不少於20小時
subItems.en: Route 1: two different activities, at least 20 hours each
subItems.detail: 選兩項不同活動，持續參與且每項累計不少於20小時；總時數不少於40小時。除活動本身外，須對所選活動的規則、術語及安全措施有足夠認識，了解該活動可能造成的傷患及預防方法，並向其他單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人分享參與心得。成員須自行擬定計劃，先諮詢主考人並取得同意才實行。活動例子詳見官方綱要，並非限於舊 A-301 至 A-312。
subItems.enDetail: Choose two different activities, each undertaken for at least 20 hours in total (at least 40 hours total). Candidates must know the selected activity’s rules, terminology and safety measures; understand possible injuries and prevention; and share takeaways with Venture Scouts from other Units, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. Draft a plan and obtain the assessor’s approval before starting. See the official syllabus for non-exhaustive examples; this is not limited to old A-301–A-312 badges.

subItems.name: 路線二：一項活動不少於52小時
subItems.en: Route 2: one activity for at least 52 hours
subItems.detail: 選一項活動，參與總時數不少於52小時。除活動本身外，須對所選活動的規則、術語及安全措施有足夠認識，了解該活動可能造成的傷患及預防方法，並向其他單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人分享參與心得。成員須自行擬定計劃，先諮詢主考人並取得同意才實行。活動例子詳見官方綱要，並非限於舊 A-301 至 A-312。
subItems.enDetail: Choose one activity and participate for a total of at least 52 hours. Candidates must know the selected activity’s rules, terminology and safety measures; understand possible injuries and prevention; and share takeaways with Venture Scouts from other Units, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. Draft a plan and obtain the assessor’s approval before starting. See the official syllabus for non-exhaustive examples; this is not limited to old A-301–A-312 badges.

items.name: 範疇三：新體驗
items.en: Category III: New Experience
items.desc: 須完成六類中的兩種不同類型；每項不少於20小時，並展示進步及分享成果。
items.enDesc: Complete two different types from the six categories; at least 20 hours each, showing improvement and sharing outcomes.
items.detail: 從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
items.enDetail: Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

subItems.name: 空中活動
subItems.en: Air Activities
subItems.detail: 包括但不限於飛機及直升機飛行員理論課、跳傘活動、飛行活動、各級空勤員章課程、飛行章課程及跳傘章課程。
subItems.enDetail: Includes but is not limited to aircraft and helicopter pilot theory, parachuting, flight activities, all levels of the Aircrew Badge syllabus, the Scout Wings course, and the Scout Canopy Wings course.

subItems.name: 海上活動
subItems.en: Sea Activities
subItems.detail:
包括但不限於獨木舟、獨木舟建造、獨木舟水球、龍舟、帆船、直立板（SUP）、SUP 水球、滑浪風帆、徒手潛水、獨木舟拯救及各級童軍標準艇課程。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Includes but is not limited to canoeing, canoe building, canoe polo, dragon boating, sailing, stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), SUP polo, windsurfing, free diving, canoe lifesaving, and all levels of the Scout Standard Boat syllabus.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

subItems.name: 資訊科技
subItems.en: Information Technology
subItems.detail:
包括但不限於電腦（例如人工智能應用）、網頁設計、可編程實體物件（例如 Arduino 及 micro:bit）、應用程式編寫、數據分析、業餘無線電及 3D 打印。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Includes but is not limited to computing (e.g. applications of artificial intelligence), web design, programmable physical objects (e.g. Arduino and micro:bit), application programming, data analysis, amateur radio, and 3D printing.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

activityOptions.name: 應用程式編寫／數據分析

subItems.name: 海外交流活動
subItems.en: Overseas Exchange Activities
subItems.detail:
參加需要至少五日住宿的海外交流活動，包括世界童軍大露營、國際或內地交流活動。

從六類中選擇兩種不同類型的新活動或進一步發展的現有活動，並展示進步；每項累計不少於20小時（合共不少於40小時）。完成後向所屬單位深資童軍、樂行童軍、其他青年或主考人介紹成果。若不確定活動是否獲接納，先向主考人查詢；須自行擬定計劃、諮詢主考人並取得批准後才開始。
subItems.enDetail:
Participate in an overseas exchange activity requiring at least five days of residential stay, including a World Scout Jamboree or international / Mainland exchange activity.

Choose two different types of new activities or further development of existing activities and demonstrate improvement; participate for at least 20 hours in total in each (at least 40 hours total). Introduce the outcomes to Venture Scouts in the Unit, Rover Scouts, other youth, or the assessor. If uncertain whether an activity is acceptable, consult the assessor first; draft a plan and obtain approval before starting.

subItems.name: 藝術
subItems.en: Arts
subItems.detail:
包括但不限於書法、陶藝、繪畫、雕塑、平面設計、絲網印刷、菲林攝影、數碼攝影、電影理論及拍攝技巧、戲劇、音樂、時裝裁剪。

items.enDetail: If the Overseas Driving or Overseas Mechanical-Transport expedition was used for the Achievement Badge, that same category cannot be used for the Bar. otherBadges.desc: 按六個選修宗教綱要之一考驗：天主教、新教、伊斯蘭教、儒教、佛教或道教；須與適當宗教人士協商。可記錄完成日期及證書編號。
otherBadges.enDesc: Choose one of six syllabuses—Catholicism, Protestantism, Islam, Confucianism, Buddhism, or Taoism—with assessment arranged with an appropriate religious person. Record the date and certificate number.
otherBadges.detail:
第十一版要求摘要：

天主教：認識聖經、唸／理解玫瑰經二十端、禮儀年、七件聖事及誓詞中「對神明盡責」；參與堂區／教友團體並交報告；理解祈禱、帶領祈禱、協助同伴參與彌撒及協助幼童軍／童軍考宗教章。

新教：持有新舊約聖經；唸主禱文及使徒信經並解釋；唱七首詩歌；講述六個聖經故事（包括出埃及及耶穌受難）；解釋「對神明盡責」；參與教會活動並交報告；解釋十字架、道成肉身及救贖、帶領祈禱、協助幼童軍／童軍考章。

伊斯蘭教：持有譯本《古蘭經》並示範使用；理解伊斯蘭意義、唸清真言及三段聖訓；認識全球穆斯林人數與香港清真寺；解釋五功及誓詞中的「對神明盡責」；協助幼童軍／童軍考章。

儒教：認識並尊重中國傳統文化與儒家思想；唸解《禮運大同篇》及《孟子經訓》；說出四書、五經、六藝、八德；唱《孔子紀念歌》並理解歌詞；引用及解釋《論語》五段；解釋「對神明盡責」；參與年度祭祀／孔孟誕辰典禮或傳統祭祀、參訪廟宇或交流並交報告；協助幼童軍／童軍考章。

佛教：持有並唸誦佛經及早晚課；唱三寶歌並理解歌詞；講述三個佛教故事、解釋因果及皈依三寶；解釋「對神明盡責」；參與浴佛節／佛教活動並交報告及已參與皈依；帶領佛教青年討論、協助成員皈依及協助幼童軍／童軍考章。

道教：持有《道德經》並解釋五章；唸《太上老君說常清靜經》並解釋；認識呂祖百字碑；說出三清名號；解釋三寶、《道德經》第八章七德及呂祖九德；解釋「對神明盡責」；參訪兩所道觀並交報告；於團活動介紹老子或仙真故事；協助幼童軍／童軍考章。

此為便覽摘要；各宗教逐項原文、合資格評核及任何修訂以第十一版手冊及總會公布為準。
otherBadges.enDetail:
11th Edition requirements summary:

Catholicism: understand the Bible, recite/understand the 20 mysteries of the Rosary, the liturgical calendar, Seven Sacraments, and “Duty to God”; participate in parish/lay association activities and report; understand and lead prayer, guide a peer in the Eucharist, and help Cub Scouts/Scouts obtain the badge.

Protestantism: own an Old and New Testament Bible; recite/explain the Lord’s Prayer and Apostles’ Creed; sing seven hymns; narrate six Bible stories including the Exodus and crucifixion; explain “Duty to God”; participate in church activities and report; explain the cross, incarnation and redemption, lead prayer, and help Cub Scouts/Scouts obtain the badge.

Islam: own/use a translated Quran; understand the meaning of Islam; recite/understand the Shahada and three Hadiths; know the number of Muslims worldwide and Hong Kong mosques; explain the Five Pillars and “Duty to God”; help Cub Scouts/Scouts obtain the badge.

Confucianism: respect Chinese tradition and Confucian teachings; recite/understand Li Yun Da Tong and Mencius passages; name the Four Books, Five Classics, Six Arts, and Eight Virtues; sing/explain the Ode to Confucius; quote/explain five Analects passages; explain “Duty to God”; participate in annual rites, Confucius/Mencius ceremonies or temple/exchange visits and report; help Cub Scouts/Scouts obtain the badge.

Buddhism: possess/recite Buddhist sutras and morning/evening chants; sing/explain the Triple Gem song; tell three Buddhist stories; explain karma and taking refuge in the Triple Gem; explain “Duty to God”; participate in Buddha Bathing and Buddhist activities and report, and have taken refuge; lead a youth discussion, assist others in taking refuge, and help Cub Scouts/Scouts obtain the badge.

Taoism: possess the Tao Te Ching and explain five chapters; recite/explain the Ode to the Supreme Patriarch; understand Lu’s Hundred Character Tablet; name the Three Pure Ones; explain the Three Treasures, seven virtues in Chapter 8 of the Tao Te Ching, and Patriarch Lu’s nine virtues; explain “Duty to God”; visit two Taoist temples and report; tell a story of Laozi/an immortal at a Unit activity; help Cub Scouts/Scouts obtain the badge.

This is a summary only. Use the 11th Edition handbook and current Association notices for exact syllabus text, eligible assessors, and amendments.

otherBadges.enDesc: An 11th Edition Venture Scout award; complete a thematic workshop and practical application within six months.
otherBadges.detail:
七個主題：環境衛生及清潔、反貪、滅罪、禁毒教育、平等機會、預防愛滋病教育、尊重知識產權。

(A) 完成至少一項總會認許的主題研習課程：能說明主題知識、相關技能／態度；解釋社區參與的目的、意義、方法及形式；描述有效規劃及組織社區活動的方法。

(B) 完成所選主題的實踐：提交至少三則相關剪報並附個人意見及可行建議；以小組完成研習並向課程／公眾簡報及帶領討論；經課程導師同意，協助推行政府活動，或策劃並執行社會服務段章項目，向主考提交計劃及報告；特定主題另須參與政府大型宣傳活動。
otherBadges.enDetail:
Seven themes: environmental hygiene and cleanliness, anti-corruption, fight against crime, drug education, equal opportunities, AIDS prevention education, and respect for intellectual property rights.

(A) Complete at least one Association-recognised thematic study course: explain the theme and relevant skills/attitudes; explain the aims, meaning, methods, and modes of community involvement; and describe effective planning and organisation of community activities.

(B) Complete practical application of the chosen theme: submit a logbook with at least three related newspaper clippings, personal comments, and feasible recommendations; complete a group thematic study and present/lead a discussion; with the course leader’s consent, assist with a Government activity or plan and deliver a Service Badge project and submit plans/reports; specific themes also require participation in large-scale Government campaigns.

trainingPlan.enTitle: Training Programme of the Venture Scout Section
trainingPlan.purpose: 深資童軍支部旨在延續童軍支部之訓練，運用執行委員會制度，以自治和自務方式配合有進度性及富挑戰性之活動及訓練誘導成員，為社會培育未來領袖。
trainingPlan.enPurpose: The Venture Scout Section extends the training of the Scout Section. Under the Executive Committee system, members are guided through self-governing and self-programming progressive and challenging activities, to nurture future leaders for society.
method: 執行委員會制度：民主選舉、會議常規、職務分工
自務自治：自行策劃組織執行檢討活動，領袖擔任顧問
多元技能：童軍技能、康樂體育、新體驗三範疇，完成任何一個獲段章，全部獲金帶
社會服務：選修部分(I)2選1 + 選修部分(II)6選1，第11版新增消防、手語、精神健康急救、SOUL Keeper、共融大使
戶外探險：遠足/單車需先完成地圖閱讀及遠足訓練，海上探險旅程需先完成海上旅程訓練
enMethod: Executive Committee system: democratic election, meeting procedure, division of duties
Self-governing and self-programming: members plan, organise, run and review activities; leaders act as advisers
Multiple Skills: Scoutcraft, Recreation & Sports, New Experiences — any one area for the Achievement Badge, all three for the Bar
Service: Elective Part (I) choose 1 of 2 + Elective Part (II) choose 1 of 6. 11th Edition adds Fire Fighting, Sign Language, Mental Health First Aid, SOUL Keeper and Integration Ambassador
Outdoor Exploration: hiking/cycling require map reading and expedition training first; a sea expedition requires Sea Journey Training first
trainingPlan.progressFlow: 會員章→肩章→深資童軍獎章(活動策劃/社會服務/多元技能/戶外探險)→榮譽童軍獎章(4金帶)
trainingPlan.enProgressFlow: Membership Badge → Epaulettes → Venture Scout Award (Project / Service / Multiple Skills / Outdoor Exploration) → Dragon Scout Award (4 Bars)
trainingPlan.assessmentPrinciples: 使用PT/65考驗計劃與團長商討，完成任何段章可佩戴該段章，建議先完成活動策劃段章。舊版自立→活動策劃、責任→社會服務、活動→多元技能、探險→戶外探險。
trainingPlan.enAssessmentPrinciples: Discuss your plan with the Venture Scout Leader using Form PT/65. On completing any Achievement Badge you may wear it. The Project Badge is recommended first. Legacy mapping: Self-reliance → Project; Responsibility → Service; Activity → Multiple Skills; Exploration → Outdoor Exploration.

legacyTransition.policy: 凡於2026年8月15日前宣誓的深資童軍，可選擇(A)按第十一版考核，或(B)沿用第十版，惟須於2029年8月14日或以前完成。逾期未完成的獎章／項目須循第十一版考核。P022/2026 附件一只列明以下章級／大類對照及限制；所有新綱要備註仍適用。此頁的勾選只新增過渡等同紀錄，不會刪改舊進度，也不會自動勾選新細項。
legacyTransition.enPolicy: Venture Scouts invested before 15 August 2026 may choose (A) the 11th Edition, or (B) continue under the 10th Edition and complete it by 14 August 2029. Any badge/item unfinished by the deadline must be assessed under the 11th Edition. P022/2026 Annex 1 states only the chapter/category mappings and restrictions shown here; all new-scheme notes still apply. A selected checkbox adds an equivalence record only: it does not delete or alter old progress and never auto-ticks new checklist items.

unmatchedItems.new: 第十一版第三章列有和平使者章、童軍世界遺產章、寰宇童軍章及地球部落；P022/2026沒有列出世界童軍環境章的直接兌換項。
unmatchedItems.enNew: The 11th Edition Chapter 3 lists Messengers of Peace, Patrimonito Scout Badge, Scouts of the World Award, and Earth Tribe; P022/2026 does not provide a direct transfer for the World Scout Environment Badge.
unmatchedItems.consequence: 已考證書及原紀錄保留，不會刪除；但不可自動當作上述任何一枚新版獎章、地球部落挑戰或新段章細項已完成。WOSM曾說 Earth Tribe 取代其 World Scout Environment Programme，但這不是香港 P022 的一對一轉換；如要考取新版獎章／挑戰，須按當前香港及 WOSM 要求另行核實。
unmatchedItems.enConsequence: Keep the earned certificate and historical record; do not automatically count it as any of the listed 11th Edition badges, an Earth Tribe challenge, or a new Achievement Badge item. WOSM describes Earth Tribe as replacing its World Scout Environment Programme, but this is not a one-to-one Hong Kong P022 transfer. Verify current Hong Kong and WOSM requirements before claiming a new badge/challenge.

categoryOnlyNotes.old: 舊童軍技能 A-101 至 A-104
categoryOnlyNotes.new: 範疇一；第十一版新增／明列步操及新的實踐細節。
categoryOnlyNotes.enNew: Area I; the 11th Edition adds/specifies Footdrill and revised practical requirements.
categoryOnlyNotes.consequence: 舊活動段章／金帶可按 P022 大類記錄等同；不可因舊四項代碼就勾選新步操或跳過新版考驗。
categoryOnlyNotes.enConsequence: Record the category-level equivalence under P022; the old four codes do not tick the new Footdrill requirement or waive revised assessments.

categoryOnlyNotes.old: 舊體育技能 A-301 至 A-312
categoryOnlyNotes.enOld: Old Sports Skills A-301 to A-312
categoryOnlyNotes.new: 範疇二康樂體育：兩項不同活動各累計不少於20小時，或一項活動參與總時數不少於52小時，另有安全、傷患預防及分享要求。
categoryOnlyNotes.enNew: Area II Physical Recreation: either two different activities, each with at least 20 hours in total, or one activity with at least 52 hours in total, plus safety, injury-prevention, and sharing requirements.
categoryOnlyNotes.consequence: P022只作範疇級對照；舊獎章名稱／一張證書本身不能證明達到新版時數及其他要求。
categoryOnlyNotes.enConsequence: P022 gives only a category-level mapping; an old badge name/certificate alone does not prove the new hours or other requirements.

categoryOnlyNotes.old: 舊個人興趣 A-203 至 A-240 及 A-999
categoryOnlyNotes.enOld: Old Personal Interests A-203 to A-240 and A-999
categoryOnlyNotes.new: 範疇三新體驗：六類中兩種不同類型，各20小時，須展示進步並分享成果。
categoryOnlyNotes.enNew: Area III New Experience: two different types among six categories, 20 hours each, with improvement and sharing.
categoryOnlyNotes.consequence: 只可作大類對照，不能按舊 A 編號逐項配對；舊 A-999 不等於新制任何自選活動。
categoryOnlyNotes.enConsequence: Category-level mapping only; old A-codes are not mapped one-to-one. Old A-999 is not automatically any new self-selected activity.

categoryOnlyNotes.new: 第十一版戶外探險段章／金帶及按路線而定的前設、距離、申請及旅程指引。
categoryOnlyNotes.enNew: 11th Edition Outdoor Exploration Badge / Bar with route-dependent prerequisites, distances, applications, and expedition guidance.
categoryOnlyNotes.consequence: P022只列章級對照。已完成舊路線不是自動完成某一新版路線；另須套用新金帶限制（段章已用境外自駕／機動化旅程者不能再用該類路線考金帶）。
categoryOnlyNotes.enConsequence: P022 maps the award level only. An old route is not automatic completion of a particular new route; apply the new Bar restriction (a driving/mechanical route used for the Badge cannot be used again for the Bar).

categoryOnlyNotes.old: 第十版其他獎章中的個別航空／海上活動章及證書
categoryOnlyNotes.enOld: Individual air/sea activity badges and certificates listed under the 10th Edition Other Awards
categoryOnlyNotes.new: 第十一版仍有空勤員章、飛行翼／傘翼及童軍標準艇三級至五級課程，但名稱、級別及課程要求按新版／最新通告。
categoryOnlyNotes.enNew: The 11th Edition retains Aircrew, Scout Wings/Canopy Wings, and Scout Standard Boat Levels 3–5, with current names, levels, and syllabus requirements.
categoryOnlyNotes.consequence: P022過渡表沒有逐枚航空／海上獎章轉換列。保留舊證書；不得僅因舊名稱近似便自動勾選新版徽章，須核實證書級別及現行總會要求。
categoryOnlyNotes.enConsequence: P022 does not provide badge-by-badge air/sea transfers. Keep old certificates; do not auto-tick a new badge based on a similar old name—verify the certificate level and current Association requirements.

newRequirements.old: 第十版童軍技能沒有此項獨立步操要求。
newRequirements.enOld: No separate Footdrill requirement in the 10th Edition Scoutcraft list.
newRequirements.new: 第十一版範疇一：完成「隊列訓練工作坊」，並完成「基本禮儀及步操訓練班」或「步操基本訓練班」。
newRequirements.enNew: 11th Edition Area I: complete the Chinese Foot Drill Workshop and either the Basic Etiquette and Foot Drill Training Course or the Foot Drill Basic Training Course.
newRequirements.consequence: 舊 A-101 至 A-104 的大類對照不會自動勾選此新細項；若考驗前已完成相關部分，可按新版追溯認可備註逐項核實。
newRequirements.enConsequence: The category-level mapping of A-101 to A-104 does not auto-tick this new item. Relevant parts completed before assessment may be recognised under the 11th Edition note; verify each part.

newRequirements.old: 第十版體育技能章按技能章考驗。
newRequirements.enOld: The 10th Edition assessed Sports Skills through badge requirements.
newRequirements.new: 第十一版新增兩條累計時數路線：兩項不同活動各不少於20小時（合共40小時），或一項活動不少於52小時；另須事前擬定計劃並取得主考人同意，熟悉規則、安全及傷患預防，並分享心得。
newRequirements.enNew: The 11th Edition offers two total-hour routes: two different activities at 20 hours each (40 hours total), or one activity for at least 52 hours. Draft a plan and obtain assessor approval first; know the rules, safety and injury prevention, and share takeaways.
newRequirements.consequence: 不得把舊章獲取紀錄自動視作新版時數與附加要求已符合。
newRequirements.enConsequence: An old badge record does not automatically prove the new hours and added requirements.

newRequirements.old: 第十版個人興趣項目按舊活動代碼考核。
newRequirements.enOld: The 10th Edition assessed Personal Interests under its old activity codes.
newRequirements.new: 第十一版要求六類中新選兩種不同類型活動或進一步發展現有活動，每項參與總時數不少於20小時，展示進步並介紹成果；活動須事前徵詢及取得主考人同意。
newRequirements.enNew: The 11th Edition requires two different types from six categories, either new activities or further development of existing activities, with at least 20 hours in total each. Show improvement and introduce the outcomes; consult and obtain the assessor’s approval before starting.
newRequirements.consequence: 單一舊興趣活動並不等於完成新版範疇三；領袖須自行核實並選擇是否記錄章級等同。
newRequirements.enConsequence: One old interest activity does not complete the new Area III; leaders verify and decide whether to record the award-level equivalence.

newRequirements.old: 第十版探險路線標準及章級限制。
newRequirements.enOld: The 10th Edition expedition route standards and award restrictions.
newRequirements.new: 第十一版路程摘要（均須符合相應日數）：段章—徒步40公里、單車160公里、境外自行駕駛650公里、境外機動化交通1,000公里（至少3個停留點，每點不少於12小時）、海上40公里；金帶—徒步60公里、單車240公里、境外自行駕駛1,000公里、境外機動化交通1,200公里（至少5個停留點，每點不少於12小時）、海上60公里。境外申請及其他前設依路線辦理。
newRequirements.enNew: 11th Edition route summary (each also has a minimum duration): Badge—hiking 40 km, cycling 160 km, overseas driving 650 km, overseas mechanical transport 1,000 km (at least 3 stops, 12 hours each), sea 40 km; Bar—hiking 60 km, cycling 240 km, overseas driving 1,000 km, overseas mechanical transport 1,200 km (at least 5 stops, 12 hours each), sea 60 km. Overseas applications and other prerequisites depend on the route.
newRequirements.consequence: 所有新路線項目維持未勾選，領袖按實際路線及新版主考指引確認；章級等同紀錄不會自動完成新旅程。
newRequirements.enConsequence: New route items remain unticked until leaders verify the actual route against the 11th Edition guidance; award-level equivalence never completes a new expedition.
